observations: Photo 0: two electronic keyboards on X-stands in a shop or room; the photo is small and low resolution.

Lower keyboard: silver body, full-width keybed that looks like 88 keys, speaker grille at the left end, blue LCD screen and rows of buttons in the middle, a small logo above the keys that is too small to read.
Upper keyboard: a different black and silver arranger keyboard behind it; it is not clear whether it is part of the sale.
A box edge at bottom right with partly visible printing, and a 'PRIME AUDIO / posted on Jiji' watermark; these are the seller's marks.
No screen is lit, so nothing shows the keyboard powering on or any keys sounding.
No power adapter, pedal or close-up of keys, buttons or the model name is shown.

identity.kind: 88-key portable grand digital keyboard (silver, with LCD screen)
read_from: photo 0 lower keyboard, shape, size and panel layout

claims.evidence: The lower keyboard in photo 0 looks like a silver 88-key portable grand with a blue LCD, consistent with the claim, but the brand logo and model name are too small to read.
Photo 0 lower keyboard shows a full-width, roughly 88-key portable keyboard with built-in speakers.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on, or may have dead or sticking keys, faulty buttons or blown speakers.
risks.proof: Clip of the keyboard switched on, playing up and down the full keyboard with sound, and pressing the main buttons.

risks.risk: Model is not readable and could be an older or lower model in the same body style.
risks.proof: Close photo of the model name on the front panel and the label on the back with the model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest model of this body style

risks.risk: Two keyboards are in the photo, so the item sold may not be the one shown or both may be offered.
risks.proof: Photo of only the keyboard for sale, close up, from the front.

risks.risk: Power adapter, sustain pedal, music rest and stand may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: as keyboard only, without adapter or stand

proof_requests: Close photo of the model name on the panel and the rear label with serial number.
Clip of the keyboard switched on, playing every key with sound and showing the screen.
Photo of all included accessories: adapter, pedal, music rest, stand.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows an 88-key portable grand digital keyboard consistent with the seller's description, so it can be priced at its worst case as a not working keyboard of that type alone, until a model label close-up and a playing clip are shown.
